docs.title: Probability
docs.subtitle: A number from 0 to 1 describing how often an outcome would happen across many identical situations.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Distribution
docs.subtitle: The full set of possible outcomes and the probability of each.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Projection
docs.subtitle: A single summary of a forecast distribution, usually its mean or median.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Variance
docs.subtitle: A measure of how spread out outcomes are around their average.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Poisson distribution
docs.subtitle: A distribution for counts of independent events in a fixed window at a steady average rate λ: P(k) = λᵏe^(−λ)/k!.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Lambda (λ)
docs.subtitle: The expected count parameter of a Poisson distribution.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Overdispersion
docs.subtitle: When observed variance exceeds what a Poisson model with the same mean allows.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Monte Carlo simulation
docs.subtitle: Estimating a probability by running a random model many times and counting outcomes.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Outcome share
docs.subtitle: The fraction of simulations that ended in a given outcome.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Confidence interval
docs.subtitle: A range that, under stated assumptions, contains the true value with a given frequency (e.g. 95%).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Standard error
docs.subtitle: The typical sampling error of an estimate; for a rate, √(p(1−p)/n).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Sample size
docs.subtitle: The number of observations behind an estimate.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Regression to the mean
docs.subtitle: The tendency of extreme results from small samples to be followed by results closer to the underlying average.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Pregame probability
docs.subtitle: A probability estimated before the event starts, averaging over every way it could unfold.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Prop (proposition market)
docs.subtitle: A market on a specific outcome within an event rather than its final result.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: American odds
docs.subtitle: Odds anchored on $100: +X is profit on a $100 stake; −X is the stake needed to profit $100.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Decimal odds
docs.subtitle: Total return per unit staked, including the stake.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Implied probability
docs.subtitle: The probability at which a price breaks even: 1 / decimal odds. It still contains the book’s margin.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Vig (vigorish, juice)
docs.subtitle: The margin a book builds into its prices so both sides’ implied probabilities sum to more than 100%.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Overround
docs.subtitle: The amount by which a market’s implied probabilities exceed 100%.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Hold
docs.subtitle: The share of total money a book keeps on perfectly balanced action: 1 − 1 / (sum of implied probabilities).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Fair (no-vig) odds
docs.subtitle: Prices implied by probabilities that sum to 100%, usually estimated by removing the vig.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Break-even rate
docs.subtitle: The win rate at which a price returns exactly zero over the long run; equal to its implied probability.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Expected value (EV)
docs.subtitle: The probability-weighted average result: p × profit − (1 − p) × stake.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Edge
docs.subtitle: The difference between an estimated probability and the (preferably no-vig) market probability.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Parlay
docs.subtitle: A combined bet that wins only if every leg wins; decimal prices multiply.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Correlation
docs.subtitle: The degree to which two outcomes tend to happen together.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Bankroll
docs.subtitle: The money set aside for betting, separate from everything else.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Flat staking
docs.subtitle: Staking the same amount on every bet regardless of perceived edge.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Kelly criterion
docs.subtitle: The stake fraction f* = (p·b − q)/b that maximises long-run growth when p is known exactly.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Drawdown
docs.subtitle: A decline from a bankroll’s peak to a later low.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: ROI (return on investment)
docs.subtitle: Net profit divided by total amount staked.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Closing line value (CLV)
docs.subtitle: How much better or worse the price you took was than the closing price.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Closing line
docs.subtitle: The last price available before an event starts.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Calibration
docs.subtitle: Agreement between forecast probabilities and observed frequencies across many forecasts.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Reliability diagram
docs.subtitle: A plot of observed frequency against forecast probability, by bucket.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Expected calibration error (ECE)
docs.subtitle: The weighted average gap between forecast probability and observed frequency across buckets.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Brier score
docs.subtitle: The mean squared difference between probability forecasts and outcomes (1 or 0). Lower is better.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Log loss
docs.subtitle: The negative average log-probability assigned to what actually happened. Lower is better.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Proper scoring rule
docs.subtitle: A scoring rule whose expected score is best when the forecaster reports their true belief.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Baseline
docs.subtitle: A simple reference forecast a model must beat, such as 50/50 or the historical win rate.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Overfitting
docs.subtitle: Fitting noise in training data so performance on new data is worse than on the data used to build the model.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Holdout set
docs.subtitle: Data withheld from fitting and tuning, used once for a final performance estimate.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Walk-forward testing
docs.subtitle: Repeatedly fitting on all data up to a point in time and scoring only the next period.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Leakage
docs.subtitle: Information from the outcome, or from after the prediction time, entering a model’s inputs.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Backtest
docs.subtitle: Evaluating a model on historical data as if it had been used at the time.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Barrel
docs.subtitle: A Statcast batted-ball classification combining high exit velocity (98+ mph) with a launch angle in a band that widen…
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Exit velocity
docs.subtitle: The speed of the ball off the bat, in mph.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: xwOBA
docs.subtitle: Expected weighted on-base average, estimated from exit velocity and launch angle (and sprint speed on some batted bal…
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: CSW%
docs.subtitle: Called strikes plus whiffs divided by total pitches.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Platoon split
docs.subtitle: A player’s performance split by the handedness of the opponent (batter vs RHP/LHP).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Park factor
docs.subtitle: An index of how a ballpark affects a stat relative to league average (100 = neutral).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Base-out state
docs.subtitle: The combination of occupied bases and number of outs (24 states).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Run expectancy
docs.subtitle: The average runs scored from a base-out state to the end of the inning.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Target share
docs.subtitle: A receiver’s targets divided by the team’s pass attempts (or team targets).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Air yards
docs.subtitle: The distance a pass travels past the line of scrimmage to the catch point or intended catch point.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Usage
docs.subtitle: A player’s share of team opportunities (snaps, routes, targets, carries, possessions).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Down and distance
docs.subtitle: The current down and yards needed for a first down.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Game script
docs.subtitle: How the score and clock shape play-calling as a game unfolds.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Anytime touchdown
docs.subtitle: A market on whether a player scores at least one touchdown in the game.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Pace
docs.subtitle: Possessions per 48 minutes (NBA) or per 40 minutes (WNBA).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Possession
docs.subtitle: A team’s continuous control of the ball, ending with a score, turnover or defensive rebound.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Minutes
docs.subtitle: Time on court; the main driver of counting stats.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Composite score
docs.subtitle: A single score built from weighted components.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Percentile
docs.subtitle: The share of a reference group that a value exceeds.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Shots on goal
docs.subtitle: Shot attempts that would have entered the net without a save.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Expected goals (xG)
docs.subtitle: The probability a shot becomes a goal given its characteristics, summed over shots.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Strength state
docs.subtitle: The number of skaters per side (5v5, 5v4 power play, 6v5 empty net).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Save percentage
docs.subtitle: Saves divided by shots on goal faced.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Scheduled rounds
docs.subtitle: The number of rounds a bout is booked for (UFC: 3 or 5; boxing: typically 4–12).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Goes the distance
docs.subtitle: A bout that reaches the judges’ scorecards without a finish.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Method probability
docs.subtitle: The probability a bout ends by a given method (KO/TKO, submission, decision).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Per-15-minute rate
docs.subtitle: A count normalised to 15 minutes of fight time: count × 900 / observed seconds.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Strike differential
docs.subtitle: Significant strikes landed minus significant strikes absorbed, usually per minute or per 15.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: 10-point must system
docs.subtitle: The standard scoring system: the round winner gets 10 points, the loser 9 or fewer.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Split decision
docs.subtitle: A decision in which two judges score for one fighter and one judge for the other.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Withdrawal
docs.subtitle: A fighter pulling out of a scheduled bout.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Game state
docs.subtitle: The compact description of an event’s current situation that the next moments depend on.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Live win probability
docs.subtitle: A win probability updated on the current game state.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Leverage
docs.subtitle: How much a single event can change the outcome probability from the current state.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Availability
docs.subtitle: Whether, and how much, a player or fighter is expected to participate.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Model card
docs.subtitle: A published document describing a model: what it predicts, training data window, out-of-sample metrics, baselines and…
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: PBE Edge
docs.subtitle: The model probability minus the de-vigged market probability, in percentage points.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Confidence tier
docs.subtitle: A label (e.g. Lean / Medium / High) describing the probability band and the evidence behind a call.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Data tier
docs.subtitle: A label describing whether enough verified data exists for a reliable output (e.g. FULL / LIMITED / INSUFFICIENT DATA).
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: No-call
docs.subtitle: A designed refusal to publish a probability or pick when the inputs would make it unreliable.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Publication gate
docs.subtitle: Pre-set criteria a model must pass before its outputs are published as official.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Shadow model
docs.subtitle: A model that runs and is evaluated privately without publishing its outputs.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Lock
docs.subtitle: The moment a call is frozen before an event; it cannot be changed afterwards.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Track record
docs.subtitle: The graded history of locked calls.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Tracking record
docs.subtitle: A graded record of real pregame decisions kept separate from the official record while a model earns promotion.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Fight DNA
docs.subtitle: PropBetEdge’s description of a fighter’s official record as normalised rates with sample-size tiers.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: Card truth
docs.subtitle: The network’s rule for which bouts are on a card: only confirmed evidence removes a bout.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY

docs.title: WinBA Score
docs.subtitle: A published WNBA composite of production percentile, win rate, winning-output share and court share.
docs.label: LEARN · GLOSSARY
